planets.name: TOI-1431 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1431 with a 2.65-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-1431 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1431. Its orbit and size follow Addison et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname ADDISON_ET_AL__2021): disc_year 2021, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.650232, pl_radj 1.49, pl_bmassj 3.12

quotes.title: TOI-1431 b
quotes.card: TOI-1431 b, also known as MASCARA-5b, is an ultra-hot Jupiter exoplanet orbiting TOI-1431 in the constellation of Cepheus.
quotes.introduction: It has an orbital period of 2.7 days.
